title: Samsung flags $80 billion profit on AI boom, highest quarterly for any tech company
key_facts: Samsung estimated third-quarter operating profit at 107.4 trillion won, or about $80.2 billion.
That is up from 89.49 trillion won in the previous quarter and 12.17 trillion won a year earlier.
Analysts had expected 106.1 trillion won, according to LSEG data.
If confirmed, it would be the biggest quarterly operating profit ever reported by a technology company, above Nvidia's $63.7 billion in its latest quarter.
Samsung gave no breakdown by division and will publish full results on 29 October.
Samsung shares closed 2.42% lower at 262,000 won in Seoul on Thursday as investors took profits.
Demand from AI data centres for high-bandwidth memory, and tight supply pushing up DRAM and NAND prices, drive the profit.
quote_evidence: The figure, if confirmed, would be the biggest quarterly operating profit ever reported by a technology company.
The company gave no breakdown by division and will publish full results on 29 October.
Samsung, one of the world's biggest memory chipmakers, is cashing in as AI data centres snap up high-bandwidth memory (HBM).
why_it_matters_hint: Memory chip demand from AI data centres is lifting Samsung's profit, but the figure is only an estimate.
